description: Candidate detailed computation taxonomy for a future finer-grained inflation substrate. This artifact is research metadata only. It is NOT wired into the operational DMI calculator, the Baseline specification, the Slack-Plus specification, or any release manifest. Core DMI remains withdrawn and unimplemented.
cpi_series_note: candidate_cpi_series_id values are CANDIDATES for a future milestone. Milestone 1 validates their structural form and uniqueness only; it does not acquire CPI data.
attribution: CPI series identifiers are published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. DMI did not originate BLS classification or index methodology.

nodes.label: Food
nodes.notes: Food at home and food away from home combined, matching CPI SAF1.

nodes.label: Alcoholic beverages
nodes.notes: Alcohol is excluded from the CPI Food aggregate but rolls up under the DMI FOOD reporting parent.

nodes.label: Shelter
nodes.notes: Includes rent of primary residence, lodging away from home, owners' equivalent rent, and tenants'/household insurance. Owner-equivalent-rent transformation is deferred to a later milestone.

nodes.label: Household energy
nodes.notes: Electricity, utility (piped) gas, fuel oil, and other household fuels.

nodes.label: Water, sewer, and trash collection services
nodes.notes: Separated from household energy because it is a non-energy utility.

nodes.label: Household furnishings and operations
nodes.notes: Furniture, appliances, housewares, tools, household supplies, and household services.

nodes.label: Apparel
nodes.notes: Not populated by Milestone 1: apparel UCCs fall outside the four audited CE domains (Food, Alcoholic beverages, Housing, Transportation). Retained so the taxonomy is complete for later milestones.

nodes.label: Transportation commodities less motor fuel
nodes.notes: New and used vehicles, motorcycles, tires, vehicle parts and equipment, motor oil and fluids.

nodes.label: Motor fuel
nodes.notes: Gasoline (all grades), diesel, and alternative motor fuels.

nodes.label: Transportation services
nodes.notes: Vehicle leasing and rental, maintenance and repair, motor vehicle insurance, motor vehicle fees, and public transportation.

nodes.label: Medical care
nodes.notes: Reachable from the audited domains only via a small number of household-operations UCCs that concord to home health care and adult day care ELIs.

nodes.label: Recreation
nodes.notes: Largely outside the four audited CE domains in Milestone 1.

nodes.label: Education and communication
nodes.notes: Reached from the Housing domain through CE telephone, internet, and information-processing UCCs.

nodes.label: Other goods and services
nodes.notes: Tobacco, personal care goods and services, miscellaneous personal services and goods.
